name: 33162 · N Miami Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33162 (N Miami Beach) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33162 (N Miami Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
90% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33162 (N Miami Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 90% of all organizations here have no identified type.
